Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the updated SOW. The technical pilot went well and our engineering team is comfortable with the latency profile. Budget is the blocker. We have a five-region rollout planned for Q4 and, to justify the annual commit to procurement, we need a deeper discount than the standard guided tiers. Specifically, procurement asked if Redwood can consider a 25% off list for the first 12 months with a trajectory back to standard pricing in year two.

If you can secure something in that range (25% first-year), we can move the contract to legal and get sign-off on a multi-year commitment.

Can you escalate for senior clearance?

Best,

Medivance

To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-05-03T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Exec review requested: Medivance — proposed 25% first-year concession

Markus / Karthik —

Summary: Medivance (Iris Cole) is requesting a 25% discount off our hosted-API unit rates for the first 12 months in exchange for a 3-year commit (annual minimums escalated year-over-year) and a five-region production rollout. Lauren attached the SOW and monthly usage forecast; projected blended ARR if they hit their ramp is $1.2M by year two.

Why approve:
- Strategic: Health-tech vertical, good reference potential, and strong likelihood of expansion beyond initial product line.
- Economics: With KV caching and prefix reuse expected, their effective token cost in year one stays acceptable even with 25% off; unit economics improve in year two as they scale.
- Timing: They want to move to legal this week — losing momentum risks them going to a competitor.

Constraints / guardrails I propose if we approve a senior variance:
1) Limit the 25% concession strictly to months 0–12.
2) Add a guaranteed annual minimum (GAM) tied to tiers in the attached forecast; if they miss GAM by >30% in any year, discount reverts and overage true-ups apply.
3) Require legal to sign an amendment capturing the reversion clause and usage audit rights.
4) Security checklist (SOC 2 evidence already provided) to be completed prior to production.

Attachments: Medivance_SOW_v3.pdf, Medivance_MAU_forecast.xlsx (see highlighted sheet for GAM calculations).

Recommendation: Approve a one-time senior variance of 25% for the first 12 months subject to the guardrails above. Requesting final sign-off.

Ben Carter
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Ben / Team —

I reviewed the economics and the proposed guardrails. Approve a one-time senior rate variance at 25% for months 0–12 under the following conditions:

1) Legal to draft an amendment with explicit GAM tiers and a reversion clause that returns pricing to our published tiers if GAM is missed by >30%.
2) Discount applies only to Hosted API usage units (text generation + embeddings). No discounts on professional services or support add-ons.
3) Security sign-off (SOC 2 evidence) must be confirmed in writing before any production rollouts to regions outside US.
4) Finance to require a 30-day audit right clause for usage reporting for the first 12 months.

Lauren — please communicate these conditions to Iris and procurement. Ask legal to prepare the amendment and loop in procurement's Jenny Park for DocuSign routing. Also lock a HubSpot task to validate GAM monthly.

Final clearance granted. Please document the variance in the deal record (DEAL-2029-0097) and include the specific discount line in the order form.

-Markus Klein
VP, Enterprise Sales
